FY2027/FY2028 paths: GW x $/GW build of the base round (inputs_detail rows 'AI revenue per GW', 'FY2027 AI revenue', 'FY2028 * GW realised', source ids 37, 38, 47, 48).
drivers.derivation: Q4 FY26 22,100 = guide $21.7B x (1 + 1.8%): record-adjusted (median first-guide beat +2.2% over 6 quarters, guidance_check), shaded for supply. FY27 115,000 = (Anthropic 5.0 + OpenAI 1.3 + others 3.7 GW) x $11.5B/GW (management 'approximately $115 billion', supply secured); quarters 24,500 / 27,500 / 29,500 / 33,500 (+11% / +12% / +7% / +14% q/q, as XPU generations ramp; Q4 heavy as in FY25-26 where Q4 was the largest quarter). FY28 195,500 = 17.0 GW x $11.5B (Anthropic 8.5 of 10, OpenAI 3.5 of >5, others 5.0), -15% vs management's $230B line of sight; quarters 40,000 / 46,000 / 52,000 / 57,500 (+19% / +15% / +13% / +11% q/q, decelerating ramp). New since the base round: Broadcom's Oct 27 8-K (id 67) shows financing arranged for the Anthropic rack leases from 2027, which supports the Anthropic GW but does not change them.
drivers.why: AI silicon is ~63% of Q4 FY26 revenue and ~78% of FY28; the horizon P/E reads FY28.

Outlook: Q2 FY26 call, networking share 'closer to around 30%' and 40% 'probably as high as' it goes; Q3 FY26 call, networking 'expected to grow just as fast as XPUs over the next few years'; Q4 FY26 'both XPUs and AI networking revenue to triple year on year'.
drivers.derivation: Actuals FY26: 0.667 / 0.61 / 0.73 (cited). FY25 quarters 0.65: not read from the FY25 calls (base year only; feeds no forecast and no filed-quarter EBIT). Q4 FY26 0.72 (both lines triple y/y). FY27 0.72-0.74, FY28 0.74-0.75: management's ~30% networking settle point, plus rack-level (memory-rich) systems for Anthropic from 2027 (8-K 2026-10-27, id 67) booked in the XPU line, which edges the XPU share up.
drivers.why: Mix lever: networking earns ~72% and XPUs ~52-59%, so each point of share moves the AI margin by ~0.2pt.
drivers.variant: Downside mix: XPU 80% by FY28 (racks heavier); upside: back to 70% (networking keeps pace).
